sections.heading: Feedback
sections.evidence: Feedback about Levenshtein.net is welcome. If you have corrections, technical comments, suggestions, or questions about the Levenshtein Algorithm and the resources available on this website, please contact us by email.
paragraphs: Feedback about Levenshtein.net is welcome. If you have corrections, technical comments, suggestions, or questions about the Levenshtein Algorithm and the resources available on this website, please contact us by email.
For technical information, return to the Levenshtein Algorithm resources or visit the Levenshtein FAQs .
